verdict.rationale: Bevy is an open-source Rust game engine library that runs as a normal dependency in the user's own project. It operates no hosted service that stores user data, so choosing a storage region or residency is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Bevy shipping any hosted data-storage capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
